candidates.change_summary: Change the return value to false at the end so the function returns false instead of true.
Return the success of the last external call rather than always true.
Return true only if the loop executed an even number of iterations; otherwise return false (changes returned value while maintaining successful execution).
Change the require in the loop to allow continuation on failed external calls instead of reverting, so transfer returns true even if some calls fail.
Invert the require on _tos.length to require that the list is empty, causing revert on non-empty arrays and changing observable success/failure behavior.
Change the call selector to a different function signature so the external calls invoke a different function and may behave differently.
Swap the order of arguments in the encoded selector call so from and _tos[i] are swapped, altering which accounts are used in external calls.
